0.0: Garbage is resilient... Defeated monsters come back to life if you leave 'em for too long. I'm glad my old pal #b#p9270030##k sent you my way. Between the two of us, we'll save #bUlu City#k yet.
0.1: Hope you're ready to pull out the big guns, because the next monsters you'll have to face are twice as strong.

yes.0: I'm too busy defending the little ground we have to venture out, so you're on your own. Hunt #b100 #o9420517#s#k and #b100 #o9420518#s#k and bring me #b75 #t4000432#s#k and #b75 #t4000433#s#k.

no.0: Coward. Just when I thought we were finally making some progress. Maybe I should just give up Ulu City for lost.

1.0: You took control of the entire area by yourself? You remind me of me, when I was young.

yes.0: We press onward! You're about to come face to face to some real mean goons.  Take a deep breath, because it might be your last.

item.0: You ain't done yet! Go hunt the rest of the monsters and get the items I asked for!
